name: simple-deployment
description: Standalone Hyperledger Fabric-only infrastructure deployment (fabric components, tools service and external CA logic)

scripts.build:contract: npm run build:contract:simple && npm run build:contract:on-prem
scripts.deploy:contract: npm run deploy:contract:simple && npm run deploy:contract:on-prem
scripts.update:contract:orgs: npm run update:contract:simple && ONBOARD_ENV_FILE=.env.onboard.orgb npm run onboard:contract && ONBOARD_ENV_FILE=.env.onboard.orgc npm run onboard:contract
scripts.onboard:up: npx jest ./tests/infrastructure/onboard-org.setup.ts --testNamePattern="Boot Infrastructure|Channel|Stop Idle Containers|Deploy Contract|Update Image Contract" --bail=1 --runInBand --config=./jest.config.cjs
scripts.infrastructure:full:up: npm run infrastructure:up && npm run infrastructure:channel:up && npm run build:contract && npm run deploy:contract && npm run copy:crypto
scripts.infrastructure:full:down: ONBOARD_ENV_FILE=.env.onboard.orgc npm run onboard:down && ONBOARD_ENV_FILE=.env.onboard.orgb npm run onboard:down && npm run infrastructure:down
scripts.infrastructure:orgs:up: npm run infrastructure:up && npm run build:contract:simple && npm run deploy:contract:simple && npm run setup:orgs
scripts.infrastructure:orgs:down: ONBOARD_ENV_FILE=.env.onboard.orgc npm run onboard:down && ONBOARD_ENV_FILE=.env.onboard.orgb npm run onboard:down && npm run infrastructure:down
